paper.title: Accurate and Robust Stellar Rotation Periods catalog for 82771 Kepler stars using deep learning

result.summary: 本文提出了 LightPred，一个用于从光变曲线中提取恒星自转周期的深度学习模型，采用结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 的双分支架构 [abstract]。模型先以自监督对比学习在 Kepler 数据上预训练，再用基于真实恒星黑子模型生成的模拟光变曲线进行监督训练 [abstract][S4.SS2.p1]。评估显示 LightPred 在准确度和平均误差上优于自相关函数（ACF）等经典方法 [abstract]，并据此生成了迄今最大的恒星自转周期目录，包含超过 80000 颗主序星 [abstract][S6.p2]。作者还通过基于学习置信度与一致性度量的误差分析过滤预测，并确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在解决如何从 Kepler 光变曲线中准确、稳健地测量恒星自转周期的问题 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。作者指出，经典方法（如 Lomb-Scargle 周期图和自相关函数）虽然成功，但耗时且难以应用于大规模数据集，并且常常难以处理具有多个周期或演化黑子图案的复杂光变曲线 [S1.p2]。此外，经典方法的一个缺点是难以提供预测的不确定性估计，而这对于评估结果可靠性至关重要 [S1.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
but can be time-consuming and challenging to apply to large datasets.
Furthermore, these methods often struggle with complex light curves that exhibit multiple periodicities or evolving spot patterns.
One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.
In this paper, we present a novel deep-learning approach for measuring stellar rotation periods using Kepler light curves.

method.text: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 组件以同时捕捉光变曲线中的时间依赖和全局特征 [abstract]。训练分为两步：首先在 Kepler 样本上以自监督对比学习（SSL）方式训练不含预测头的模型，然后将该权重作为初始化，在模拟数据集上进行基于模拟的监督学习（SBSL）[S4.SS2.p1]。模拟光变曲线使用真实的黑子模型生成，训练时同时预测周期和倾角，作者认为这种相互学习可使两方面各自受益 [S2.SS1.p2]。模型还引入了一种新的误差度量，结合了与预测一同优化的学习置信度，以及基于同一恒星不同片段预测一致性的度量 [S1.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: The model utilizes a dual-branch architecture combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer components to capture temporal and global data features.
To train the model, we used a 2-step pipeline; First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
Next, we used the weights from the SSL Step as an initialization for supervised training with the mock dataset.
By training a model to predict periods and inclinations at the same time we rely on the fact that mutual learning can benefit both aspects independently.

We use new error metric which combines a learned confidence level, optimized together with the predictions, and a consistency measure based on the ability to reproduce the same predictions on different segments of the same sample.

experiments.text: 模型在 50000 个模拟样本（时长 1000 天）上进行监督训练，并按 81%、9%、10% 划分为训练、验证和测试集，得到 5000 个测试样本和 4500 个验证样本 [S4.SS2.p1]。作者尝试将数据集加倍至 100000 个样本，发现结果无显著变化，因此保留 50000 个样本 [S4.SS2.p1]。在 Kepler 数据上，作者筛选出出现在连续 8 个季度的样本，共 130868 个，用于 SSL 步骤和推理 [S5.SS2.p1]。与 ACF 的比较在全部样本以及一个遵循一般筛选规则（去除行星宿主星和食双星，且 ACF 能对所有片段给出预测）的子样本上进行，该子样本大小为 36154 [S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days that were generated as explained in II.1 and II.2.
We then split the dataset into training ( $81\%$), validation ( $9\%$), and test sets ( $10\%$).
This gave us 5000 samples for testing and 4500 samples for validating the model which is representative.
We experimented with doubling the dataset size to 100000 samples and found no significant change in the results so we decided to keep the dataset size with 50000 samples.
This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
The size of the second sub-sample is 36154, i.e. only $\sim\frac{1}{3}$ of the data.

findings.text: LightPred 在准确度和平均误差上优于 ACF 等经典方法 [abstract]，并生成了迄今最大的恒星自转周期目录，包含超过 80000 颗主序星 [abstract][S6.p2]。与三个最大的现有 Kepler 周期目录比较显示，模型置信度越高的样本一致性越好，表明学习到的置信度反映了物理性质 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。不一致的样本主要分布在两个区域：半周期线附近（暗示双周期错误）以及参考周期接近零而模型预测不为零的区域 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。此外，作者确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Our evaluation demonstrates that LightPred outperforms classical methods like the Autocorrelation Function (ACF) in terms of accuracy and average error.
We apply LightPred to the Kepler dataset, generating the largest catalog to date.
This advancement has led to the generation of the largest and most accurate catalog of stellar rotation periods for main-sequence stars to date, comprising over 80000 stars.
It can be seen that in general, more confident samples have better agreement.
This implies that the learned confidence represents physical properties and is somehow similar to the scoring functions used in and.
The first region is around the half period line Which suggests a ’double period mistake’.
The second region is where the reference period is close to zero but our model’s predictions aren’t.
Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.

limitations.text: 作者指出，观测到的光变曲线可能不代表单一目标，拥挤（Kepler 像素覆盖 4″×4″ 天区）可能导致多个天体进入同一孔径，从而引入偏差 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。双星系统也可能使模型偏向错误的周期（例如双星的轨道周期）[S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。此外，作者提到倾角测定比自转周期测定更具挑战性，因此本文仅将倾角作为辅助变量，留待未来工作处理 [S2.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: It is possible that the observed light curve does not represent a single object but multiple objects.
since Kepler pixels cover $4^{\prime\prime}$ x $4^{\prime\prime}$ patch of sky it is plausible that multiple objects would enter a single aperture.
A system of multiple stars can bias the model towards an incorrect period (the orbital period of the binary for example).

We therefore treat inclination and period predictions separately; in this paper, we investigate the period predictions and treat inclinations as an auxiliary variable, while in a future paper, we will focus on the more complex issue of inclination determination.
